criteria.requirement: Add packaging.utils.parse_legacy_sdist_filename(filename,expected_name=None). For tar.gz/zip enumerate every split whose project name validates and version parses, deduplicate semantic pairs preserving order. Without expected_name return all valid candidates as a tuple and never silently choose. With a normalized validated expected project name return only a unique matching (name,Version) pair, otherwise InvalidSdistFilename. Support legacy post releases and hyphenated names, reject unsupported extensions/no-valid-split. Existing modern parse_sdist_filename behavior remains unchanged.
